SELECT txregistry, paymethod, escrowused, routecomplexity, payamtusd, txfinishhrs, escrowhrs, 
       (payamtusd * txfinishhrs) / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0) as calc1,
       (payamtusd + txfinishhrs + escrowhrs) as calc2,
       (payamtusd / NULLIF(txfinishhrs, 0)) as calc3,
       (payamtusd / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0)) as calc4
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT txregistry, paymethod, escrowused, routecomplexity, payamtusd, txfinishhrs, escrowhrs,
       (payamtusd * txfinishhrs / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0)) / 1000 as calc_per_mille,
       (txfinishhrs * 100.0) / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0) as ratio_pct,
       (payamtusd * 100.0) / NULLIF(txfinishhrs * escrowhrs, 0) as calc2,
       (payamtusd + txfinishhrs * 100) / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0) as calc3
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT txregistry, payamtusd, txfinishhrs, escrowhrs,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) + (txfinishhrs * 0.5) - (escrowhrs * 0.3) as formula1,
       (payamtusd / NULLIF(txfinishhrs, 0)) * (NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0) / 100.0) as formula2,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) * (txfinishhrs / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0)) as formula3,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) - (txfinishhrs / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0)) as formula4
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT txregistry, payamtusd, txfinishhrs, escrowhrs,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) + txfinishhrs - escrowhrs as f1,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) + txfinishhrs * 0.1 - escrowhrs * 0.1 as f2,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) + (txfinishhrs - escrowhrs) as f3,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) * (txfinishhrs / NULLIF(escrowhrs, 0)) as f4
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT txregistry, payamtusd, txfinishhrs, escrowhrs,
       (payamtusd / 1000.0) + txfinishhrs - escrowhrs as calc_val
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex'
ORDER BY calc_val DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN (payamtusd / 1000.0) + txfinishhrs - escrowhrs > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as suspicious,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (payamtusd / 1000.0) + txfinishhrs - escrowhrs <= 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normal
FROM transactions 
WHERE paymethod = 'Crypto_B' AND escrowused = 'No' AND routecomplexity = 'Complex';

SELECT m.mktdenom as market_name, 
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.risk_category = 'Suspicious Pattern') as suspicious_count,
       COUNT(*) as total_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.risk_category = 'Suspicious Pattern') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as suspicious_percentage
FROM transactions t
JOIN markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
GROUP BY m.mktdenom
ORDER BY suspicious_percentage DESC, suspicious_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
